pacman-aur: Upgrade hook failures: 'error: command failed to execute correctly' from the mkinitcpio, dkms, or 90-linux.hook hooks during -Syu, and how to tell a fatal hook failure from a cosmetic one (the transaction has already committed)

DKMS module build failure during a kernel upgrade (nvidia-dkms / virtualbox-host-dkms) leaving a kernel with no working module — needs linux-headers matching the installed kernel and 'dkms autoinstall'
/boot or the ESP running out of space mid-kernel-upgrade ('Not enough free disk space' on a 260MB FAT32 ESP), which strands you between an installed kernel package and a missing vmlinuz/initramfs

Package conflict prompts during -Syu: ':: X and Y are in conflict. Remove Y? [y/N]' and provider-selection prompts (jack2 vs pipewire-jack, wireplumber vs pipewire-media-session) — answering wrong uninstalls half a desktop
'Running makepkg as root is not allowed' and the related sudo/user setup for AUR builds (referenced obliquely in several records but never given its own entry)
Signature failures for third-party repos specifically — chaotic-aur/cachyos keyring not installed, 'signature is unknown trust' pointing at a non-Arch key, and SigLevel handling per-repo
Verifying installed files against the package database with 'pacman -Qkk' / paccheck after a crash or bad disk, to find truncated or missing files before they cause runtime failures
pacman -Syu refuses to proceed because of held-back packages: IgnorePkg/IgnoreGroup or HoldPkg on pacman/glibc, and the partial-upgrade state that follows
AUR package renamed, merged, or replaced upstream ('target not found' for a package you have installed) and how to migrate off it

Recovering when /var/lib/pacman/sync or the cache lives on a full filesystem: 'error: Partition /var too full' during the download phase versus the commit phase, and safe emergency space reclamation order
network: MediaTek mt7921e/mt7922 Wi-Fi dead or not re-enumerating after suspend (ASPM/L1SS), a very common modern laptop failure with no record here at all
Realtek rtw88 parts (RTL8821CE/8822CE) needing `options rtw_pci disable_aspm=1` or the AUR rtl8821ce-dkms driver — rtw89 is covered but rtw88 is not
NetworkManager-wait-online.service / systemd-networkd-wait-online delaying boot by 30-120s, one of the most-reported Arch boot complaints (omarchy masks the networkd one but not NM's)
WPA3 / SAE association failures and the WPA2-WPA3 transition-mode handshake problem on wpa_supplicant vs iwd
6 GHz / Wi-Fi 6E and 7 channels unavailable because the regulatory domain is world (country 00) and 5 GHz/6 GHz channels are marked no-IR
Hyprland/Wayland has no running polkit agent or NM secret agent, so the Wi-Fi password prompt never appears and connections fail with 'secrets were required but not provided'
mDNS / .local hostname resolution failing — avahi vs systemd-resolved MulticastDNS, nsswitch.conf mdns_minimal ordering, and ufw blocking UDP 5353 so LocalSend/KDE Connect/printers are undiscoverable
MTU / PMTU black holes on PPPoE, VPN and some hotspots — SSH and HTTPS hang mid-transfer; fix via ethernet.mtu / wifi.mtu or TCP MSS clamping
Interface renamed by predictable naming or a udev .link change after an upgrade, orphaning NetworkManager profiles pinned to the old name (touched on only as a footnote in the iwd record)
Bluetooth headset has no microphone / HSP-HFP profile missing or mSBC not negotiated under PipeWire+WirePlumber
Bluetooth pairing lost on every Windows dual-boot because the link keys diverge, and how to copy them out of the Windows registry
2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth coexistence interference on shared-antenna combo cards (throughput collapse while a BT audio device is connected)
Tailscale exit-node and --netfilter-mode interaction with ufw/firewalld and Docker, beyond the accept-dns/accept-routes case covered
USB tethering / Android RNDIS interface not appearing, and ModemManager not installed or enabled for WWAN/5G modems
r8169 vs r8168-dkms for RTL8111/8168 gigabit NICs (link flapping, no link at gigabit) — only the RTL8125 offload bug is covered
audio-input: Media/volume key bindings on bare Hyprland - record 0 lists 'volume keys do nothing' as a symptom but nothing in the set ever covers binding XF86AudioRaiseVolume/LowerVolume/Mute/MicMute to wpctl, or XF86MonBrightness to brightnessctl. On a bare Hyprland session these are not bound by default and this is one of the most common first-day complaints.

Mouse pointer acceleration and sensitivity - no record covers input.accel_profile ('flat' vs 'adaptive'), input.sensitivity, force_no_accel, or per-device mouse tuning via hl.device(). 'My mouse feels wrong/accelerated after switching from X11' is a top-tier Hyprland input complaint and is entirely absent.

Microphone noise suppression and echo cancellation - no coverage of PipeWire's module-echo-cancel drop-in or the RNNoise LADSPA filter-chain config, which is the standard answer to 'people hear my keyboard/fan on calls' and pairs naturally with the mic-too-quiet record.

PipeWire sample rate and resampling configuration - nothing on ~/.config/pipewire/pipewire.conf.d/ default.clock.rate / allowed-rates / quantum, which is the fix for USB DACs stuck at 48 kHz, apps that resample audibly, and 'my hi-res DAC shows the wrong rate'.

Game controller / gamepad input - xpadneo for Bluetooth Xbox controllers, xone for dongles, and the general 'controller pairs but no input' path. Genuinely an input-device topic with well-known Arch wiki coverage and zero records here.

snd-hda-intel codec model quirks - `options snd-hda-intel model=...` (and hda-verb / patch files) for laptops where the speakers, headphone jack, or internal mic never work despite firmware being present. This is the classic escalation past the SOF-firmware record and is not mentioned.

/etc/bluetooth/main.conf tuning - AutoEnable, FastConnectable, Experimental (needed for headset battery reporting via upower), and ControllerMode. Records 14-16 cover connection failures but never touch the main daemon config that governs adapter power-on at boot and reconnect behaviour.

Audio devices disappearing or going silent after suspend/resume - record 7 offers `alsactl init` in passing, but there is no dedicated record for the common case where the whole card vanishes from wpctl after resume and needs a module reload or a systemd sleep hook.
gpu-drivers: NVRM API mismatch after a partial upgrade or an un-rebooted kernel update: 'NVRM: API mismatch: this kernel module has version X but this NVIDIA driver component has version Y', or modprobe failing because /usr/lib/modules/$(uname -r) was replaced mid-session. Fix is a full `pacman -Syu` (never `pacman -Sy <pkg>`) plus a reboot — this is the single most common NVIDIA-on-Arch breakage and nothing here covers it.

Secure Boot and DKMS module signing: nvidia/nvidia-open DKMS modules refuse to load ('Key was rejected by service' / module not found) when Secure Boot is enabled, requiring MOK enrollment (sbctl / mokutil) or a signing hook.
nouveau loading instead of the proprietary driver, and the reverse: leftover /etc/modprobe.d blacklists, or nouveau grabbing the card first, leaving `nvidia-smi` working but the compositor on Mesa.

AMD GPU hangs / resets: '[drm] *ERROR* ring gfx_0.0.0 timeout' and 'amdgpu: GPU reset begin' on RDNA2/RDNA3 under gaming load, plus the amdgpu.gpu_recovery / amdgpu.noretry / mesa VM-fault workarounds.

Brand-new Intel/AMD hardware not probing: `i915.force_probe=<id>` / `xe.force_probe=`, and choosing between the i915 and xe kernel drivers on Meteor Lake / Lunar Lake / Arc — the i915-vs-xe split is only touched obliquely in the module-order record.
Steam/Proton 32-bit graphics failures: 'libGL error: failed to load driver' or 'vulkan: no DRI3 support' from missing lib32-mesa / lib32-vulkan-* / lib32-nvidia-utils after enabling multilib.
HDMI 2.1 limitations on AMD (no 4K@120/144 over HDMI because the spec forbids an open implementation; workaround is DisplayPort or a DP-to-HDMI adapter) — a frequent 'my monitor caps at 60Hz' report.
Hyprland fails to start with 'Couldn't open a DRM device' / no GPU found: user not in the video/render group, running under a nested session, or seatd/libseat and logind permission problems.
GPU-accelerated screen capture and sharing beyond VA-API: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland + PipeWire missing, which makes screen share show a black window on NVIDIA even when VA-API is fine.

Kernel-parameter editing for Limine specifically (Omarchy's default bootloader): several records say 'edit the cmdline: line in /boot/limine.conf' but none covers limine-entry-tool / omarchy-cmdline-add or regenerating the config, so users on Omarchy 4 have no verified procedure.
display-monitors: Mirroring displays: the `mirror = "DP-2"` monitor field is documented on the Monitors wiki page and is a constant support question (presentations, clamshell mirroring). Omarchy even ships bin/omarchy-hyprland-monitor-internal-mirror and binds it to Super+Ctrl+Alt+Delete, but no record covers it, nor the fact that mirrors do not appear in plain `hyprctl monitors` (only in `monitors all`).

HDR and 10-bit color: `bitdepth = 10`, the `cm` presets (srgb/wide/hdr/hdredid), `sdrbrightness`/`sdrsaturation`, `render:cm_auto_hdr`, and the documented side effects (Hyprland border colors do not support 10-bit; some apps cannot screen-capture with 10-bit enabled; washed-out SDR content in HDR mode). This is one of the highest-traffic monitor topics on Hyprland right now and is entirely absent.

Workspace-to-monitor binding surviving monitor changes: workspace rules with `monitor = "DP-1"`, and what happens to those bindings when the monitor is absent at login or its connector name shifts. Closely related to the desc: record but never addressed.

Wallpaper and bar not appearing on a newly connected monitor: hyprpaper/swww having no wallpaper for an output that appeared after startup, and Waybar/Quickshell needing a restart to draw on a new display. A very common docking complaint distinct from the compositor-level records here.

Mixed-refresh-rate multi-monitor stutter: a 60 Hz and a 144 Hz display side by side causing animation judder or the whole desktop rendering at the slower rate, and the interaction with `debug:vfr` and per-monitor rendering.

EDID overrides for monitors that report bad or no EDID: the kernel `drm.edid_firmware=` / `video=` cmdline mechanism and /lib/firmware/edid placement, which is the standard fix when a KVM, long HDMI run, or cheap adapter mangles the EDID. The modeless record touches the symptom but not this remedy.
Overscan/underscan on TVs (black borders or cut-off edges over HDMI) and the `reserved_area` monitor field, which the Monitors page documents but no record mentions.
hypridle/hyprlock behaviour on multi-monitor: external displays not waking from DPMS after the idle timeout, and the lock surface appearing on only one output.
power-suspend: Battery charge thresholds - the single most-asked laptop power question and completely absent: /sys/class/power_supply/BAT0/charge_control_start_threshold and charge_control_end_threshold, TLP's START_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT0/STOP_CHARGE_THRESH_BAT0, the ThinkPad (tp_smapi/natacpi) and ASUS (asusctl, charge_control_end_threshold) variants, and why the value silently resets after suspend or reboot without a tmpfiles.d/udev rule

amdgpu resume failures - black screen or corrupt display after suspend on AMD laptops and desktops, 'amdgpu: [drm] *ERROR* ring gfx_0.0.0 timeout' / 'Failed to disable requested IRQ' in the journal, and the standard workarounds (amdgpu.dcdebugmask=0x10 to disable PSR panel self-refresh, amdgpu.runpm=0, amdgpu.sg_display=0). Record 13 covers black-screen-on-resume only for hibernate and early KMS; ordinary suspend on amdgpu is untouched despite AMD being Omarchy's most common hardware

Hibernation with an encrypted root or encrypted swap - resume= pointing at the /dev/mapper node rather than the raw partition, cryptdevice= plus resume= interaction, the encrypt hook needing to precede resume (mentioned only in passing in records 7 and 8), sd-encrypt vs encrypt differences, and why a LUKS2 header with high argon2 memory cost can break resume in the initramfs

Suspend blocked or delayed by an inhibitor - `systemd-inhibit --list` as a first-line diagnostic for 'systemctl suspend does nothing', browser/Steam/mpv idle and sleep inhibitors, delay vs block inhibitor semantics, InhibitDelayMaxSec, and Hyprland/hypridle's own ignore_dbus_inhibit and ignore_systemd_inhibit options. Only touched incidentally under lid handling

Bluetooth dead after resume - a distinct and very common failure from the USB autosuspend case in record 22: btusb needing a reload via a system-sleep hook, `sudo systemctl restart bluetooth.service` after resume, AutoEnable=true in /etc/bluetooth/main.conf, and the interaction with rfkill state restore

Debugging which device is blocking or failing suspend - the generic method that would let a user diagnose most of the records here themselves: /sys/power/pm_debug_messages, /sys/kernel/debug/suspend_stats, `dmesg | grep -i 'PM: suspend entry\|PM: suspend exit'`, /sys/kernel/debug/wakeup_sources sorted by wakeup count for s2idle, per-device /sys/devices/.../power/async and pm_test, and AMD's amd_s2idle.py script

Machine will not power off, or hangs at shutdown/reboot after a suspend cycle - a frequent follow-on to the suspend bugs listed here, with the usual reboot=bios/reboot=acpi and 'a job is running for ...' timeout angles

Thermal throttling despite low temperatures - PROCHOT and power-limit throttling on ThinkPads (the `throttled` package / lenovo_fix), RAPL constraint tuning under /sys/class/powercap/intel-rapl, and reading throttle causes from /sys/class/thermal and turbostat. Record 26 covers the fan-noise side but not the opposite complaint of unexplained low clocks
hyprland-config: Monitor configuration failures generally - the single most common Hyprland config problem. Monitor not detected, wrong resolution/refresh rate, `hyprctl monitors all` to list disabled outputs and supported modes, `monitor = <name>, disable`, mirroring (`mirror` position), `transform` for rotated panels, and the 'preferred'/'highres'/'highrr' mode keywords. Only GDK_SCALE is covered (record 24).

XWayland scaling: `xwayland { force_zero_scaling = true }` plus GDK_SCALE / QT_AUTO_SCREEN_SCALE_FACTOR / QT_QPA_PLATFORM / Xft.dpi to get crisp XWayland apps on a scaled display. Record 24 tells users to 'accept integer scaling' without mentioning the actual documented remedy.

NVIDIA setup beyond the os.execute bug: nvidia_drm.modeset=1 (and modeset=1 now default in recent drivers), nvidia-open vs proprietary, `AQ_DRM_DEVICES` for hybrid/multi-GPU laptops to pick the render node, black screen or flicker on wake, and `cursor { no_hardware_cursors = true }`. Record 20 covers only why the env vars fail to get set, not what they should be.

Cursor problems: invisible, giant, or X11-vs-Wayland mismatched cursors. XCURSOR_SIZE / XCURSOR_THEME, `hyprctl setcursor`, hyprcursor vs xcursor themes, and cursor:no_hardware_cursors for NVIDIA. Very common and entirely absent.

Environment variable scope: `hl.env()` / `env =` only reaches processes Hyprland launches after that line, never systemd user services or anything started before the compositor. Needs `systemctl --user import-environment` or dbus-update-activation-environment. Record 18 covers only the portal-specific case.

Workspace rules: `hl.workspace_rule` / `workspace = ` for persistent workspaces, pinning workspaces to specific monitors on multi-monitor setups, `default:true`, gapsout/border overrides per workspace, and why workspace-to-monitor assignments reset on hotplug.

hyprlock and hypridle config errors after the 0.55 Lua move. These hypr* tools deliberately stayed on hyprlang (the 26_lua post says so explicitly), so users migrating hyprland.conf to Lua often try to convert hyprlock.conf/hypridle.conf too and break their lockscreen - a locked-out-of-your-machine failure mode.

Screen sharing and the portal picker: xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland configuration (xdph.conf, which Omarchy ships), hyprland-share-picker, choosing window vs monitor vs region, and OBS/Discord/browser screen capture showing black. Records 16 and 18 touch permissions and startup ordering but never the capture path itself.

hyprlang `$variable` definitions ($mainMod, $terminal) have no direct Lua equivalent - a very common breakage during 0.54 -> 0.55 migration, alongside `source =` -> `require()` relative-path resolution errors.

Input configuration itself: input:kb_layout / kb_variant / kb_options (grp:alt_shift_toggle, caps:escape), per-device input blocks via `hl.device`, `hyprctl devices` to get the device name, and touchpad natural_scroll / disable_while_typing. Records 12 and 22 both assume the layout is already configured correctly.
Live testing before committing: `hyprctl keyword` (hyprlang) / `hyprctl eval` and `hyprctl repl` (Lua) to try an option without editing files, and `hyprctl setprop` for per-window property testing.
Tearing, VRR and gaming: misc:vrr values, the `immediate` window rule for tearing, and gamescope as the wiki's blanket recommendation for Proton issues.
omarchy-core: Omarchy 3 -> 4 'Quattro' upgrade failures (bin/omarchy-upgrade-to-quattro) - the single biggest current Omarchy-core issue: the move from a ~/.local/share/omarchy git checkout to pacman-packaged /usr/share/omarchy, and the .conf -> .lua Hyprland config conversion that silently strands user customizations. Its absence is why most records in this set still describe the v3 layout.
Hyprland config migration from .conf to .lua: user overrides in ~/.config/hypr/*.conf stop being sourced after the upgrade, so keybindings/monitor scale/input settings silently revert.

'omarchy update' aborting on insufficient free space (bin/omarchy-update-requires-free-space) and btrfs ENOSPC with snapshots consuming the root subvolume - snapper NUMBER_LIMIT=5 plus a full disk is a common update blocker.

pacman 'file exists in filesystem' conflicts during update - Omarchy handles this with --overwrite '/usr/share/omarchy/*' and a dedicated omarchy-update-system-pkgs-when-conflicted fallback, but users hitting it manually have no guidance.
Stale or held update lock (bin/omarchy-update-lock) - a killed update leaves the lock held and every subsequent 'omarchy update' refuses to start.
The omarchy-update-pacman-guard itself: users who deliberately want a direct pacman transaction hit the 'Woah partner...' abort and do not know about OMARCHY_ALLOW_DIRECT_PACMAN=1.
Direct Boot hiding the Limine menu (Setup > Direct Boot) and thereby making snapshot rollback unreachable without selecting Limine from the firmware boot menu.
Waybar / top bar crash-loop and the Update > Hardware recovery path (omarchy-restart-*) for wifi, Bluetooth, audio and trackpad that stopped working without a reboot.
Theme system breakage - omarchy-theme-set, ~/.config/omarchy/current/theme dangling symlinks after a failed update, and per-app theme files not regenerating.
AUR silently skipped during updates when the AUR is unreachable (omarchy-pkg-aur-accessible), leaving foreign packages stale indefinitely.
Firmware updates via Update > Firmware / fwupd, including updates that can only be written during a reboot.
Web app launchers (omarchy-webapp-*) breaking after a Chromium or theme update.
wayland-compat: Input methods / IME broken in Electron and Chromium apps on Wayland — no CJK or compose input until you pass --enable-wayland-ime (or --wayland-text-input-version=3) plus fcitx5 with GTK_IM_MODULE/QT_IM_MODULE/XMODIFIERS set correctly; one of the single most-reported Wayland app-compat problems and entirely absent here

System tray / status notifier icons missing for Electron, Java and Qt apps (Discord, Steam, Nextcloud, KeePassXC) — requires an SNI host in the bar and libappindicator; XEmbed trays do not exist on Wayland
Wrong or invisible mouse cursor in XWayland apps and games — XCURSOR_THEME/XCURSOR_SIZE not reaching XWayland, hyprcursor vs xcursor mismatch, and the giant-or-missing cursor in Steam/Proton games
Drag-and-drop failing between XWayland and native Wayland apps (dragging a file from the file manager into an XWayland Electron app, or between browser and editor)
No audio when screen sharing — Discord/Meet/OBS capturing video but not application or desktop audio, needing a PipeWire loopback or monitor source selection
Flatpak app compatibility: apps not seeing the host GTK/Qt theme or cursor, Flatpak portals vs host portals, and flatpak override --env/--filesystem for Wayland variables
Wine and Proton on the native Wayland driver — enabling the Wayland graphics driver in winecfg / PROTON_ENABLE_WAYLAND, and the XWayland fallback when it misbehaves
Electron and Chromium keyring failures — 'password store' prompts on every launch, needing --password-store=gnome-libsecret or basic, plus gnome-keyring in the session
GTK4/libadwaita and Qt apps not following the system dark theme because the org.freedesktop.impl.portal.Settings color-scheme is not being served by any backend
Middle-click primary-selection paste behaving differently or not at all between XWayland and Wayland clients
Virtual camera / v4l2loopback for OBS output into Zoom, Meet and Teams on Wayland
Apps that request keyboard-shortcut inhibition (VMs, VNC/RDP clients, remote desktop) capturing or failing to capture the compositor's own binds
boot-kernel: NVIDIA early-KMS black screen at boot: nvidia_drm.modeset=1 / nvidia-utils vs nvidia-dkms version skew after a kernel update, and the nvidia modules missing from the initramfs after a DKMS build failure — the single most common 'boots to a black screen after -Syu' report on Arch/Omarchy

/boot (or the ESP) not mounted during pacman -Syu: the kernel and initramfs get written into the empty /boot directory on the root filesystem instead of the ESP, pacman reports success, and the next boot fails — detection via findmnt /boot and lsblk, and repair by mounting and reinstalling the kernel

Kernel command line rescue parameters for getting in without a live USB: systemd.unit=rescue.target / emergency.target, single, init=/bin/bash with mount -o remount,rw /, and nomodeset for GPU-related black screens — plus how to add them at the GRUB/Limine/systemd-boot menu

Btrfs metadata exhaustion: 'No space left on device' from mkinitcpio or pacman while df shows free space, diagnosed with btrfs filesystem usage / df and fixed with btrfs balance start -dusage=... — a common cause of a truncated initramfs on the Btrfs-by-default distros this skill targets

archlinux-keyring out of date blocking any upgrade ('invalid or corrupted package (PGP signature)', 'signature from ... is unknown trust') after months without updating, and the pacman-key --populate / -S archlinux-keyring-first ordering — the gate that stops users reaching every other fix here

fsck failure on an unclean shutdown dropping to a maintenance shell: 'UNEXPECTED INCONSISTENCY; RUN fsck MANUALLY', running fsck -f on an unmounted root from a live USB, and the fstab pass-number / fsck hook interaction

UEFI NVRAM boot entries silently dropped or NVRAM full: efibootmgr entries disappearing after every reboot on certain firmware, and the /EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI removable-media fallback as the durable workaround

Snapshot boot entries missing from the Limine menu on Omarchy (limine-snapper-sync not running, snapper unconfigured, or .snapshots not a separate subvolume) — the record set assumes snapshot rollback works but never covers it failing

mkinitcpio.conf.pacnew / limine.conf.pacnew handling: an upgrade ships a new default HOOKS or preset, the user's customisations sit in the old file, and boot breaks on the next rebuild — pacdiff workflow

Plymouth-related boot hangs and the LUKS password prompt never appearing (plymouth hook ordering, plymouth-encrypt vs encrypt), which is directly relevant given Omarchy ships plymouth in its HOOKS array
omarchy-theming: Hyprland window border/gradient colors not following a theme change (staged hyprland.lua + omarchy-restart-hyprctl), including the case where a git-installed theme's hyprland.lua is stripped as .lua and the generated template's borders look wrong
SDDM login/logout screen not matching the theme, and omarchy-refresh-sddm vs the package-owned /usr/share/sddm/themes/omarchy assets
System tray icons in the Quickshell bar missing, duplicated, or stuck after an app restart (StatusNotifierItem/AppIndicator apps such as Signal, Dropbox, NordVPN, 1Password)
Cursor theme and size not following the theme or not applying to XWayland apps (hyprcursor vs XCURSOR_THEME/XCURSOR_SIZE and the Hyprland env block)
omarchy theme install failing or hanging on a non-git, private, or redirecting URL (omarchy-git-url-check), and how to remove a half-installed theme with omarchy theme remove
VS Code / VSCodium not picking up the theme because omarchy-theme-set-vscode installs an extension that a git-installed theme is forbidden to declare (vscode.json is on INSTALLED_THEME_DENIED)
Bar missing, duplicated, or on the wrong monitor after a monitor hotplug, resolution change, or lid open/close, and per-monitor bar limitations with mixed-DPI scaling

Theme switcher and background picker showing blank tiles because a theme ships no preview.png / preview-unlock.png, and clearing the picker cache (omarchy-theme-bg-cache, omarchy-theme-switcher --preload)
Retint of btop, tmux, starship, helix and obsidian silently failing or hanging as one of the post_theme_commands entries, and how to bisect which entry in run_parallel is blocking
Light-mode detection going wrong for user themes: mode = "light" vs the legacy light.mode marker vs background-luminance guessing, giving dark text on dark surfaces in GNOME/GTK apps
Bar font/icons not updating after omarchy font set because the shell caches the resolved face, versus the shell.toml file-watch path
Lock screen and screensaver surfaces not following the theme (shell.lock.toml section override) after a partial theme with no shell.toml
